author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
Candidates for this position are preferred to be based in Bangalore, India and will be expected to comply with their team’s hybrid work schedule requirements.
  
  
Senior Manager, Product Management
  
  
**Team:** Customer Technology
  
**Location:** Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
At Wayfair, we're working to make shopping more personal, relevant, and easier for millions of customers.
  
  
The Customer Understanding team builds the intelligence that helps Wayfair better understand what customers like, what they're looking for, and how their needs change over time. We turn customer behavior and signals into shared capabilities that power better search, recommendations, personalization, and shopping experiences.
  
  
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of Product, AI/ML, and customer experience, solving problems at scale and shaping how Wayfair understands and serves its customers.
  
  
Learn more about our technology teams on the[1] Wayfair Tech Blog.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
**Think big and work backwards from the customer:** Imagine what a great shopping experience could look like, identify gaps in how we understand customers, and define what we need to build.
  
  
**Shape strategy, not just a roadmap:** Challenge assumptions, solve ambiguous problems, and build a clear point of view on where to invest and why.
  
  
**Work at the cutting edge of AI/ML and data:** Partner with ML, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Platform teams to build scalable products, balancing model quality, performance, reliability, and cost.
  
  
**Connect technology to customer impact:** Work with Search, Recommendations, and other teams to turn customer intelligence into better shopping experiences, and validate the impact with experiments.
  
  
**See the bigger picture:** Connect opportunities across teams, customer journeys, and businesses. Bring fresh thinking from industry trends and advances in AI.
  
  
**Navigate complexity and drive progress:** Work across distributed teams with different priorities, build alignment, make trade-offs, and move things forward without waiting for perfect clarity.
  
  
**Own outcomes, not just delivery:** Take products from discovery to launch and adoption, measure real impact, and adapt based on what you learn.
  
  
What We're Looking For
  
  
9+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex products and delivering measurable customer or business impact.
  
  
Strong product thinking, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems, identify opportunities, and build a clear strategy.
  
  
Experience working with Engineering, Data Science, or ML teams on data-driven, platform, or algorithmic products.
  
  
Strong analytical skills and experience using customer insights, data, and experimentation to guide decisions.
  
  
Ability to understand technical concepts and trade-offs, while staying focused on customer problems and business outcomes.
  
  
Strong communication and collaboration skills, especially when working across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  
  
It's a Plus If You Have
  
  
Experience in e-commerce, personalization, search, recommendations, or customer data products.
  
  
Familiarity with customer embeddings, intent modeling, recommender systems, or cold-start personalization.
  
  
Experience building ML-powered products or reusable data and intelligence platforms.
  
  
References
  
  
Visible links
  
1. https://www.aboutwayfair.com/careers/tech-blog

author: Hiring Manager
title: Sr. Product Manager I
job_description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it's what we show up for every day.

We are looking to hire a Senior Product Manager I to own the integrations and agentic ecosystem for Brandfolder, Smartsheet's Digital Asset Management platform. This is a high-growth, strategically critical product area. It covers how Brandfolder connects to the tools where marketing and creative teams work, and how AI agents find, use and govern brand content through MCP, connectors, APIs and partner integrations.

Your work will determine whether Brandfolder is the trusted source of brand content for people and AI agents alike. This is an individual contributor role for a product leader with strong technical fluency, deep customer instincts and the confidence to drive a complex, cross-surface product area across multiple engineering teams and external partners.

**You Will**
------------

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Brandfolder's MCP server, connector framework, public API and integrations and make clear prioritization and sequencing decisions
* Define how AI agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot discover, retrieve, create and update brand assets, while keeping permissions, usage rights and brand governance intact
* Lead the evolution of Brandfolder's integration portfolio
* Define the API and agent-readiness strategy: authentication, scopes, rate limits, webhooks, tool design and developer experience for customers, partners and AI clients
* Own the quality, reliability and supportability of existing integrations, and shape the migration path from legacy connectors to the new platform
* Lead customer and partner discovery sessions to validate assumptions
* Author crisp product briefs, requirements and technical specs that design and engineering can execute without ambiguity, from discovery through GA and post-launch
* Drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, security, GTM, Customer Success, Support and partner teams
* Define success metrics for every feature, such as integration adoption, active accounts, agent task success, API usage and work with data teams to ensure instrumentation from day one
* Represent product in leadership reviews, MBRs, partner conversations and customer engagements
* Contribute to packaging and pricing decisions for integrations and AI capabilities

**You Have**
------------

* 4+ years of product management experience delivering high-impact features in enterprise SaaS or B2B software
* Experience owning platform, API, integration, connectors or developer-facing product areas, including how products work with AI models and agents is a strong plus
* Experience with content, digital asset management, marketing technology or workflow products is a plus
* Proven ability to navigate ambiguous, technically complex problem spaces and make clear scoping and sequencing decisions across multiple engineering teams and external partners
* A working understanding of authentication and authorization (OAuth, SSO, role-based permissions), APIs and webhooks, and data security considerations for AI
* Strong customer instincts: you run structured discovery, synthesize signal and turn it into well-scoped, validated decisions
* A track record of excellent product briefs, requirements and specs that engineering acts on without ambiguity
* Demonstrated ability to drive alignment across engineering, design, security, GTM and Customer Success, including third-party partner dependencies
* A data-driven mindset: you define adoption, funnel, quality and reliability metrics before you ship and use post-launch data to guide iteration
* Excellent written and verbal communication

**Get to Know Us:**

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you're doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that's magic at work. Let's build what's next, together.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager Intern
job_description:
**Revvity**

Revvity is a developer and provider of end-to-end solutions designed to help scientists, researchers, and clinicians solve the world’s greatest health challenges. We pair the enthusiasm of an industry disruptor with the experience of a longtime leader. Our team of 11,000+ colleagues from around the globe are vital to our success and the reason we’re able to push boundaries in pursuit of better human health.

Find your future at Revvity.

**Ready to RiseUp?**

Through Revvity's RiseUp Internship Program, students and recent graduates gain hands-on experience, work on meaningful projects, and build skills for future success. With dedicated support and opportunities to learn, collaborate, and grow, our interns make an impact from day one. Click here to learn more

**Job Application Process**

1) Review the Job Description in detail

**2) Complete the mandatory questionnaire**https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/agdKBU4dTM (opens in new window)

3) Submit the application on Workday

  
  

Only candidates who complete the questionnaire and apply for Job on workday will be considered for further evaluation.

  
  

Revvity is looking for a Product Manager Intern.

About you:

You have a curious nature and keep abreast of new developments or ideas gaining momentum in the business. You want to know how and why people use technology and understand how they imagine better ways of working. You interject yourselves into the conversation to ask questions that help others clarify any problems, assumptions and risks. You are outgoing, a people’s person, can put people at ease and are easy to talk to. You are curious and want to help your team answer their toughest questions by learning from others and working together.

Requirements:

* Strong interest in artificial intelligence and its practical applications in business

* Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and AI technologies

* Engaging with UX designers, UX researchers, developers and stakeholders to define and document clear product requirements

* Prioritizing and planning features based on company and stakeholder priorities and business values

* Distilling very technical concepts to business colleagues and vice versa

* Presenting information to others (e.g., to the design team/business stakeholders)

* Define and track success metrics

* Work with software engineering teams on bug triage and requirements

* You’re open to rolling up your sleeves and doing a bit of end-user research and testing as needed, to make the team and product a success

* Ability to effectively communicate in both oral and written English

Some of the other things we care about:

* Worked previously on an AI based product either as a PM or developer

* You are able to empathize with our end-users and are interested in doing some research.

* Using analytical tools and conducting product-related analyses to produce actionable insights and communicate findings

* Knowledge of user-centered design methodologies

* Believe that discussion, inclusivity and transparency result in better products

* Are eager to learn from your team and others. We value making each other successful!

* A willingness to try new things and a love of learning

* You’re a go-getter, with a keen desire to get things done

Using the “OCEAN” model which stands for Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness and Neuroticism, we’re looking for the following personality traits:

Openness – The ability to take on new challenges and learn new things.

Conscientiousness – The ability to work independently and deliver high-quality work.

Extraversion – The ability to communicate directly with customers and users, and to present your work clearly and effectively to different stakeholders as needed.

Agreeableness – Be kind and thoughtful. We value people who are respectful of others and who are willing to jump in and help where and when needed.

Neuroticism – Although we try and minimize stress levels, there will be deadlines to meet. Plans can change, so the ability to pivot and adapt to changing priorities will be important.

title: Product Manager - Trade| Mumbai
job_description:
Job Description
  

1) Design, Develop, update and implement product and process circulars
  
2) Keep abreast with the overall trends in the related products and constantly interact with ground level teams to get client feedback on existing products
  
3) Run a P&L for the owned products and facilitate to maximize the product coverage in the portfolio of clients
  
Responsible for overall regulatory, operational, credit hygiene of the products and work towards improving same continuosly
  
4) Liase with internal teams to ensure building a robust corr bank relationships to facilitate the cross border business
  
5) Liase with operations team to take feedback on improvements and process enhancement on the products
  
6) Keep abreast of all the latest regulatory guidelines with regards to compliance for trade products, eg: EDPMS, IDPMS, Capital account transactions etc
  
7) Create, run, maintain, publish dashboards for business teams, product sales teams and senior management to show the position on various regulatory compliances position of the clients with respect to trade products where CSB Bank is the AD bank of the client, (IDPMS/EDPMS/Capital account txns)
  
8) Facilitate through liasioning with FEMA Compliance teams to solve complex cases of pending compliances relating to clients where CSB is the AD bank

  
Responsibilities
  

.

  
Qualifications
  

Experience Range : 5 to 10 Years

Qualifications :
  
Graduate (Any Specialisation)
  
MBA

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
* R024224

* Pune, Maharashtra, India

* IT Operations

* Regular

  

**Location Details:** **Pune, Hybrid**

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time, others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This position may be a hybrid or fully remote position, as decided by your manager. If designated as hybrid, you’ll divide your time between working remotely from your home and an office location, so you should live within commuting distance. If designated as remote, you’ll be working remotely from your home and may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings. Your hiring manager can share more about this role’s hybrid or remote designation.

**Join Our Team...**

At GoDaddy, we are driven by our mission to make opportunity more inclusive. We are looking for a dedicated Senior Product Manager to join our Risk Services team in India. This role offers the flexibility of remote work alongside in-person collaboration.

As a Senior PM on the Risk Services team, you'll have the outstanding opportunity to build trust across GoDaddy’s brands, products, and services. We aim to protect our customers, partners, and vendors from bad actors and help prevent, detect, and recover from financial, reputational, and customer data loss. Working with us means you'll be part of a world-class team, passionately dedicated to delivering flawless solutions to manage and mitigate risk.

**What you'll get to do...**

In this role, you will work across the entire GoDaddy organization to address account risks. You will evolve our risk management capabilities to power solutions that balance risk and business performance.

* Leading product strategy for account risk management by crafting adaptable capabilities that can be applied across all risk areas.
* Defining requirements and the roadmap for platform and internal tools supports low reaction time, coverage, and precision. This helps meet the needs of an ever-changing risk landscape.
* Working closely with business, engineering, operational, and design collaborators across GoDaddy brands and units to measure risk gaps. We find opportunities to improve performance and build scalable solutions.
* Supporting measures to bolster our account risk management framework while encouraging business progress and elevated customer experience.
* Leading discussions with senior leaders on business performance and opportunities within the risk management space.

**Your experience should include...**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/other technical/engineering field or equivalent applicable experience.
* 5+ years of experience in Product Management or equivalent capability for an eCommerce web services product.
* Experience applying strong business insight and technical vision for a product area and using both technical and operational capabilities to build solutions.
* Demonstrated success managing medium to large complex projects in an eCommerce setting.
* Proficiency with web services, generative and agentic AI, and API development, with a curiosity to always learn more in this ever-changing technical landscape.

**You might also have...**

* Master's degree in a technology or business-related field, or equivalent experience.
* Direct experience in risk management or payments within a large-scale eCommerce setting.
* Experience bringing to bear rules engine and machine learning techniques for anomaly detection.

*We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.*

**We've got your back...**We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.

**About us...** GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us.

At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our Diversity Careers page.

We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (Culture). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way.

*GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer**.* *GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.* *Refer to our full* *EEO policy.*

Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com.

**GoDaddy doesn’t accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.**

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Platform Product Manager
job_description:
**About us**

Hyperproof is on a mission to transform the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) world with a powerful new software platform. With Hyperproof, companies can save time and money while also operating their programs at a much higher level of effectiveness and accountability. We envision a world where organizations we depend on are truly trustworthy - and Hyperproof is the platform that will get them there.

We have a great team and culture - picture yourself in a highly collaborative startup environment where you can make a real impact on something truly important. It's an exciting time to be at Hyperproof; we raised our Series B round in 2023, validating our teamwork and company vision, and we continue to grow rapidly.

We are seeking a visionary and hands-on Principal Platform Product Manager to serve as a product leader and GRC domain strategy owner across our platform. In this high-impact individual contributor role, you will define and execute our holistic AI product strategy, driving the next generation of agentic systems, trustworthy automation, and eval-driven GRC workflows. You will focus on high-impact problem selection, grounding, and auditability to ensure our intelligent features deliver provable value and measurable time-bound outcomes within rigorous compliance guardrails.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* **AI Product Vision & Strategy:** Own the end-to-end strategy, architecture, roadmap, and execution for Hyperproof's platform AI capabilities, intelligent agents, and automated workflows covering the full spectrum of the platform capabilities.
* **Eval-Driven & Strategic Product Leadership:** Partner directly with engineering and GRC subject matter experts to author detailed product requirements, establish trust and grounding frameworks, define rigorous eval-driven development benchmarks, and maintain strict auditability and AI safety guardrails.
* **Agentic Workflows & Automation:** Lead the innovation of customer-facing AI agents and backend service integrations that automate complex, everyday GRC tasks for enterprise customers.
* **Cross-Functional Architecture Alignment:** Collaborate with executive stakeholders, engineering, design, and GRC domain experts to define constraint spaces, evaluation frameworks, and model integration standards across the platform. Ensure continuous partnership and alignment with go-to-market teams and establish strong customer relationships that drive product innovation aligned with the most important customer use cases.
* **Data-Driven & Experimental Validation:** Build rapid functional prototypes, analyze product usage metrics, establish rigorous eval benchmarks, and leverage customer feedback to continuously validate and improve AI features in production.
* **Thought Leadership & Market Advisory:** Serve as Hyperproof's subject matter expert on AI in governance, risk, and compliance at industry events, executive briefings, and customer advisory sessions.

**HOW YOU'LL KNOW YOU ARE SUCCESSFUL**

* Hundreds of enterprise companies, including well-known Fortune 500 customers, rely daily on your AI agents and workflows to automate compliance with provable, verifiable outcomes.
* Customers post rave reviews highlighting the speed, accuracy, and reliability of Hyperproof's AI features.
* You set the technical and strategic bar for AI product development across the company, elevating the capabilities of cross-functional team members.
* You successfully translate emerging AI/LLM technology advancements into defensible, high-value product opportunities that differentiate Hyperproof in the market.
* You drive measurable, time-bound business outcomes that increase platform efficiency and reduce manual compliance effort for enterprise customer teams.

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING**

* 8+ years of product management experience scaling enterprise SaaS platforms, with 2+ years of direct experience shipping production-grade AI/LLM products, agentic systems.
* Strong product leadership in AI application, with preferably deep understanding of GRC problem ownership, grounding, trust frameworks, auditability requirements, and eval-driven product development methodologies.
* Ability to act as a principal advisor, using professional concepts to resolve critical organizational issues and broad design challenges across engineering and product teams.
* Exceptional communication skills with a proven track record of bridging technical depth (engineering specs, model evals) with executive strategy and enterprise customer alignment.
* Demonstrated experience establishing AI safety, governance, verifiable results, and precision guardrails in production software.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

**WHAT WILL BE A PLUS**

* Hands-on technical background in software engineering, spec-driven development, or data science.
* Domain experience in Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), cybersecurity, or highly regulated enterprise environments.
* Hands-on familiarity with agent measurement tools, Claude Code, or developer-centric AI tooling.

**LOCATION**

* We are a fully remote company! Rather than restrict ourselves to only finding talent in one city, we'd rather find the absolute best people regardless of where they live.

**CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE**

* We value your time and want you to know what to expect from us. For this interview, we expect to ask you to participate in {Interview outline of meetings} and expect this to be completed in {hours}.
* 1st Interview Talent Acquisition
* 2nd Interview Hiring Manager
* 3rd Interview
* 4th Interview
* 5th Interview
* Total Time: 3.5 Hours

**WHERE YOU'LL GO**

* Hyperproof also loves to see an internal transfer. If a linear career path is not what you're looking for, you can work with your manager and our people team to explore lateral moves to other parts of the organization as you continue to grow with us.

**WHAT WE OFFER TO OUR EMPLOYEES**

**Please note: Benefits listed below are for employees in the United States; contractor roles or international positions may differ**

* Annual compensation reviews + equity
* Unlimited PTO: strongly encouraged to unplug and recharge
* Health: coverage for medical, dental, and vision - employee and dependents
* 401K, which vests immediately, complete with a 4% company match
* 12 weeks of Parental leave and 1 year free diapers and wipes with Honest
* Annual company in-person events and quarterly in-person connects
* $500 home office stipend - at the time of hire. Any additional home office needs are requested as needed.
* $100 quarterly paid wellness stipend
* Pet insurance discount
* Slack channel notifications turn off after 5 pm based on your time zone
* Two Hypercharge weeks of rest where we close company-wide (July & Dec)

It's an exciting time to be at Hyperproof — we recently raised $40 million in our Series B financing, further cementing Hyperproof as the emerging leader in the risk and compliance management space.

At Hyperproof's core are our passionate team members who focus on user experience, beautiful design, and evangelize a positive social impact of our cloud based platform. We help organizations streamline their risk and compliance workflows so our customers can spend more time strategically managing programs and less time wrangling spreadsheets.

We are disrupting the governance, risk, and compliance software space with our innovative platform by helping traditionally unsung heroes (compliance professionals) **do the right things so the wrong things don't happen.**

Learn more about the @hyperproof culture and how it all started.

**A NOTE ABOUT OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS**

We're committed to creating a fair, respectful, and secure hiring experience for everyone. As part of that commitment, we use standard verification steps throughout our interview process.

Here's what that means for you:

* We may conduct routine verification checks during the hiring process.
* You might be asked additional questions to better understand your experience and background.
* For video interviews, we ask that candidates be on camera without filters or visual modifications.

These steps are applied consistently for all candidates and are designed to ensure an equitable experience for everyone.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**

Hyperproof is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace — it's one of our core values! Hyperproof is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

To ensure a smooth interview process, all candidates will be required to provide a valid phone number that is *not* a VOIP (Voice Over Internet Protocol) number. This helps us maintain clear and reliable communication throughout your interview experience.

title: Senior Digital Product Manager - Platform Product Management
job_description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Digital Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of platform capabilities that enable scalable, innovative digital experiences across the enterprise. This role requires a highly collaborative product leader with strong technical acumen, capable of partnering closely with engineering, design, and architecture teams to build reusable platform services and foundational capabilities that drive meaningful business outcomes.

**In this role, you will:**

* Define and execute the product strategy, roadmap, and priorities for enterprise platform capabilities and services.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, design, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and reusable platform solutions.
* Translate complex business and technical requirements into product capabilities, features, and prioritized backlogs.
* Drive product discovery, customer research, and data-driven decision-making to identify opportunities and increase platform adoption.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to evaluate technical trade-offs, scalability requirements, integration patterns, and platform architecture decisions.
* Define product requirements, success metrics, and acceptance criteria while balancing customer value, business impact, and technical considerations.
* Establish platform standards, API design principles, developer experience best practices, and governance frameworks.
* Monitor platform performance, adoption, and customer feedback to continuously enhance the product experience.
* Champion AI-enabled capabilities and automation opportunities that improve customer experiences and business outcomes.
* Influence stakeholders across business and technology organizations to align priorities, drive execution, and deliver measurable results.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of Digital Product Management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, or education.
* 2+ years of platform product management experience supporting platform, API, developer, infrastructure, or enterprise technology products.
* Strong technical background with experience defining product strategies and roadmaps, leading platform product initiatives, and partnering with engineering teams to deliver scalable technology solutions.
* Experience integrating AI-driven capabilities into digital products and customer experiences.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while effectively managing multiple priorities.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Proven success managing the full product lifecycle, from discovery and strategy through execution, launch, and optimization.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams to assess technical trade-offs, scalability requirements, and solution design considerations.
* Ability to build strong partnerships and collaborate effectively across business, product, engineering, architecture, and operations teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills within complex, matrixed organizations.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and facilitate discussions that drive clarity, alignment, and decision-making.
* Demonstrated knowledge of Agile software delivery methodologies, information architecture, digital platforms, and modern software engineering practices.
* Proactive, innovative, and customer-centric mindset with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Job Expectations:**

* Strong technical and product management expertise, with experience defining product strategies and roadmaps while partnering with engineering teams to deliver scalable platform capabilities, modernization initiatives, and enterprise technology solutions.

**Posting End Date:**

25 Oct 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

title: Senior Product Manager - APAC
job_description:
Date live: 10/22/2026

Business Area: Investing and Lending

Area of Expertise: Investment Banking

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000131619

  

Join us as Senior Product Manager - APAC, where you will be responsible for the development and oversight of our loan and overdraft products across India, broader Asia and the Middle East. You will work closely with loan originators and broader stakeholders across the region, including coordinating new product approvals, performing annual product reviews, and acting as the business product owner in the region to help prioritise technology and process changes. You will also work closely with Operations and Technology on the rollout of our strategic loan platform across the region. The role will sit with our Investment Banking Origination team in Mumbai and report jointly to the Global Head of Loan Product Management and the Global Head of Loan Transformation.

  
  

To be successful in this role, you should:

Be a strong and ambitious candidate at Vice President level with strong product management, business analysis, stakeholder management and loan product knowledge, along with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

  
  

Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications:

* Strong business analysis skills, including the ability to capture key requirements.
* Strong bilateral and syndicated loan product knowledge.
* Strong communication, relationship management and networking skills.
* Strong product management skills.
* Ability to capture key requirements and summarise them into management-style presentations and proposals.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
* Ability to challenge existing ways of working and drive process improvements.
  

  

Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications:

* Good presentation and PowerPoint skills.
* Understanding of process design, optimisation and ownership, with a focus on client outcomes and operational effectiveness.
* Exposure to product ownership models within complex, multi-stakeholder organisations.
* Understanding of regulatory requirements and controls within lending processes.
* Experience working in agile or hybrid delivery environments.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as:

* Contributing to and influencing policies and procedures for the function, and planning, managing and consulting on multiple complex and critical strategic projects which may be business-wide.
* Providing expert advice to business and functional management and committees to influence decisions.
* Escalating breaches of policies and procedures appropriately.
* Fostering and guiding compliance, ensuring regulations are observed and relevant processes are in place to facilitate adherence.
* Focusing on the external environment, regulators or advocacy groups to both monitor and influence on behalf of Barclays, when appropriate.
* Maintaining broad and comprehensive knowledge of industry theories and practices within the relevant discipline, alongside up-to-date sector and functional knowledge and insight into external market developments and initiatives.
* Negotiating with and influencing stakeholders at a senior level, both internally and externally.
* Acting as a principal contact point for key clients and counterparts in other functions and business divisions.
* Acting as a mandated spokesperson for the function and business division.
  

  

Job location is Mumbai.

**Purpose of the role**

To develop and manage the wholesale lending products and services, collaborating with, and ensuring service standards are complied with by, business partners across the bank, including investment bankers, credit analysts, risk managers, and operations professionals, to ensure that our products meet the needs of the bank's clients and are aligned with the bank's overall strategic objectives whilst ensuring all governance, control, regulatory and legal requirements are met.

**Accountabilities**

* Development and execution of product strategy for financial products and services offered within the wholesale division. .
* Identification of investments opportunities and customer needs to create new products or enhance existing ones. .
* Management of the entire product lifecycle, including product planning, development, launch, and ongoing management, including oversight of service levels. .
* Analysis of market data to make informed decisions regarding product positioning and pricing. .
* Assessment and management of risks associated with lending products and implement risk mitigation strategies, including the operation of and attendance to governance forums. .
* Oversight of regulatory and technological change.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior Product Manager - AI
job_description:
**Vacancy Name**

Senior Product Manager - AI

  

**Vacancy No**

VN1077

  

**Job Title**

Senior Product Manager - AI

  

**Work Location City**

Bangalore

  

**About Solifi**

Solifi deliver a solid financial technology foundation for equipment, working capital, wholesale, and automotive finance firms. At Solifi, we believe that commerce is only as strong as the system it runs on. Our mission is to reshape finance technology by bringing together proven solutions into a singular powerful technology platform designed to help protect and scale financial organizations. We guard our customers by being precise and reliable, we guide their success by combining powerful technology with proven expertise, and we help them grow by unleashing their potential.

  

**About the Team**

We are a small, high ownership AI team operating with the pace and ownership of a startup within a global enterprise. We build production grade AI products that are used by real customers, taking ideas from early experimentation and prototyping through evaluation, production deployment and continuous improvement. The team brings together AI product management, AI engineering and data expertise, with a strong emphasis on shipping, experimentation, quality and measurable customer outcomes. We work closely with product, engineering and domain teams across the business to identify where AI can create meaningful value and then build the systems required to deliver it reliably at scale. This is an opportunity to work on some of the core AI products shaping how modern AI is applied within enterprise software, while having significant influence over what we build, how we evaluate it and how AI products are built and operated in production.

  

**About the Position**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - AI to lead the development of production grade AI products that solve complex problems for enterprise customers.
  
  
This is a highly hands on product role for someone who understands that building AI products is fundamentally different from building traditional software. You will work at the intersection of product, data, AI, and domain expertise, with significant ownership over both the product outcome and the process used to prove that the AI system can reliably deliver it.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will not simply manage a backlog of AI features or translate requirements between customers and engineering. You will be expected to understand the problem, formulate the hypothesis, work with the data, determine how AI can solve it, establish how success will be measured, validate the solution and drive it all the way into production.
  
  
The goal is not to build AI for the sake of using AI. The goal is to build reliable, production-grade AI products that create measurable value for enterprise customers.

  

**Role and Responsibilities**

Identify high value customer problems, develop hypotheses around where AI can create measurable value and validate those hypotheses using data, experimentation and customer feedback.
  
  
Work hands on with large and complex datasets to understand the problem, identify patterns, test assumptions, and determine what is required to build an effective AI solution.
  
  
Partner with AI engineering and data teams to design AI powered product experiences, including grounding and retrieval systems, prompts, model selection, orchestration and AI workflows.
  
  
Build and own AI evaluation frameworks, including evaluation datasets, golden sets, test cases, metrics, automated evaluations, and human evaluation processes.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability for production systems and use evaluation and production data to identify failures, understand root causes and continuously improve the product.
  
  
Drive AI capabilities from prototype and proof of concept through production deployment, customer adoption and continuous improvement.
  
  
Define and measure the product and AI metrics that demonstrate whether the system is delivering the intended customer outcome.

  

**About You**

What We Are Looking For: • 7+ years of product management experience, with significant experience building and shipping B2B software products. • Strong hands-on experience building AI-powered products, where AI is a core part of the product experience and customer outcome. • Deep practical understanding of AI evaluation and experience building evaluation frameworks for AI products. • Strong experience with AI monitoring and observability, including identifying, diagnosing, and addressing failures in production AI systems. • Strong data skills and experience working with large-scale data. You should be comfortable understanding data structures, exploring datasets, analyzing data, and using data to validate product hypotheses and AI behavior. • Experience designing and building grounding systems and evaluation systems, rather than simply consuming AI APIs. • Experience with modern AI application architectures, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompting, model selection, agents/workflows, and orchestration. • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous problem, formulate hypotheses, validate them with data and experimentation, and turn the resulting insight into a production product. • Experience building products for B2B customers in heavily regulated industries, such as financial services, fintech, insurance, healthcare, or similar domains. • Strong understanding of enterprise AI considerations including accuracy, reliability, explainability, security, governance, data quality, and auditability. • Ability to work deeply with technical teams and engage in detailed discussions about AI system behavior without needing to be the engineer implementing the system. • Familiarity with the AWS ecosystem is preferred. • Strong product judgment and the ability to distinguish between an impressive AI demo and an AI system that is genuinely reliable enough for production use. What Will Set You Apart: • You have taken an AI product from hypothesis prototype evaluation production continuous monitoring and improvement. • You have personally designed or owned an AI evaluation framework and understand why evaluation is central to building reliable AI products. • You have worked through difficult AI failure modes and know how to investigate whether a problem originates in the model, data, retrieval, grounding, prompting, orchestration, or product workflow. • You have experience building AI products where incorrect outputs have meaningful business or customer consequences. • You are comfortable challenging an initial hypothesis when the data or evaluations do not support it. • You naturally think in terms of measurable customer outcomes rather than AI features. • You enjoy getting into the details and are equally comfortable discussing a customer workflow, analyzing an evaluation dataset, investigating AI output failures, and working with engineers on the product architecture.

  

**Preferred Experience Level**

7 years

  

**Preferred Education Level**

Master's Degree

  

**Employment Basis**

Full Time

  

**Benefits**

Group Medical Insurance, Group Personal Accident, Employee Anniversary gift, Loyalty Bonus, Employee Referral Bonus, Rewards and Recognition program, Wellness Allowance, Privilege Leave (PL): 15 days per year, Casual Leave (CL) 12 days per year, Maternity/paternity/Bereavement leave

  

**Applications Close Date**

07 Apr 2027

You should be comfortable understanding data structures, exploring datasets, analyzing data, and using data to validate product hypotheses and AI behavior. • Experience designing and building grounding systems and evaluation systems, rather than simply consuming AI APIs. • Experience with modern AI application architectures, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompting, model selection, agents/workflows, and orchestration. • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous problem, formulate hypotheses, validate them with data and experimentation, and turn the resulting insight into a production product. • Experience building products for B2B customers in heavily regulated industries, such as financial services, fintech, insurance, healthcare, or similar domains. • Strong understanding of enterprise AI considerations including accuracy, reliability, explainability, security, governance, data quality, and auditability. • Ability to work deeply with technical teams and engage in detailed discussions about AI system behavior without needing to be the engineer implementing the system. • Familiarity with the AWS ecosystem is preferred. • Strong product judgment and the ability to distinguish between an impressive AI demo and an AI system that is genuinely reliable enough for production use. What Will Set You Apart: • You have taken an AI product from hypothesis prototype evaluation production continuous monitoring and improvement. • You have personally designed or owned an AI evaluation framework and understand why evaluation is central to building reliable AI products. • You have worked through difficult AI failure modes and know how to investigate whether a problem originates in the model, data, retrieval, grounding, prompting, orchestration, or product workflow. • You have experience building AI products where incorrect outputs have meaningful business or customer consequences. • You are comfortable challenging an initial hypothesis when the data or evaluations do not support it. • You naturally think in terms of measurable customer outcomes rather than AI features. • You enjoy getting into the details and are equally comfortable discussing a customer workflow, analyzing an evaluation dataset, investigating AI output failures, and working with engineers on the product architecture.

  

**Preferred Experience Level**

7 years

  

**Preferred Education Level**

Master's Degree

  

**Employment Basis**

Full Time

  

**Benefits**

Group Medical Insurance, Group Personal Accident, Employee Anniversary gift, Loyalty Bonus, Employee Referral Bonus, Rewards and Recognition program, Wellness Allowance, Privilege Leave (PL): 15 days per year, Casual Leave (CL) 12 days per year, Maternity/paternity/Bereavement leave

  

**Applications Close Date**

07 Apr 2027

job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product backlog and prioritization of user stories with team members
* Manage Capital fund and work directly with Finance to ensure we our budget is in line
* Establish success metrics, OKRs (Objective and Key Results), and go-to-market plan and help lead
* Product owners in meeting their Business Objectives
* Be the voice of the customer and end-user; proactively provide customer feedback to internal teams. This includes being the voice of the service organization that is closest to the customer.
* Practical understanding of Scrum principles and practices
* Partners with Scrum master's in supporting Scrum Framework
* Shares and decomposes Features into user stories (non-technical)
* Develop a deep understanding of the customer and product needs
* Recognized voice of the business to the team
* Test, validate and identify weaknesses in prototypes and make the necessary changes (A/B, research, analysis, usability, etc.)
* Build, manage and develop a team of business analysts/testers.
* Ensures traceability between requirements to Features to user stories
* Review of test cases against user stories acceptance criteria
* Periodically re-prioritize the Product Backlog based on customer feedback, market changes and business priority as communicated by the Product Manager
* Formally accepts the user stories once all acceptance criteria are met
* Actively participates in Product Backlog grooming sessions, retrospectives, defect management and project team's release planning sessions
* Accessible for the team to answer questions, and during Sprint planning sessions, and Daily Scrum
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements.

**What you will need to be successful:**

* **Vision**: Always looking through the lens of the consumer and thinking of how to make their life better
* A solid understanding of User Experience: Experience in product management, product development, and User Experience design
* **Ability to ask Why:** Comfortable asking the right questions to quickly understand the core of the user needs
* **Instinct**: Solid consumer product instincts
* **Dig Deep:** Being able to dig in and go all the way down the rabbit hole to identify those unique opportunities
* **Collaboration**: Experience incubating and commercializing new ideas by working closely with technical and creative teams. Ability to navigate and lead through a complex matrix organization to deliver outcomes
* **Communication**: Ability to present and hold a dialog in a variety of forums: executive, front-line and industry events
* Influence without authority: Provide guidance and information to business for prioritizing high value work

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or 5+ years of additional relevant experience
* 5+ years of experience with Product Owner, Project Management and / or Business Analysis
* 5+ years of experience working in a contact Center/Call Center Environment
* 3+ years working with Finance managing budgets and financial goals
* Experience driving teams and management to decisions
* Experience working with cross functional teams
* Experience systematically analyzing problems, drawing relevant conclusions, and devising appropriate courses of action

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in working with Agile / Scrum work environment as a Product Owner: writing user stories, and following the development process through user story acceptance
* Experience working with IVR or call technology systems
* Healthcare insurance industry experience
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio and Outlook
* Demonstrated ability to effectively break down barriers to maintain progress on initiatives
* Demonstrated ability to make quick decisions when clarification or modification is needed
* Proven diplomatic with solid negotiation and conflict resolution skills
* Proven adept at adjusting to changing circumstances quickly and professionally
* Proven excellent oral, written and interpersonal communication with both technical and business audiences
* Demonstrated strategic thinking by using appropriate information to diagnose problems, identify possible solutions and collaborate with impacted groups to drive decisions
* Proven self-directed and able to drive detailed solutions to completion with minimal oversight
* Proven detail oriented and obsessively organized

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

job_description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

  
  
**Job Description**

* Define product requirements, work with engineering teams, and deliver solutions that meet user needs. Scope includes driving transformational growth across our Sports Research and Consulting products and solutions, as well as our Video Games Tracking research.
* Requires at least ten years of specialized depth and breadth of expertise relating to **multi-country quantitative research,** including questionnaire and code frame design, research process automation using AI, advanced analytical modelling and visualization of complex analytical outcomes from these data types. Also requires a strong proven understanding of marketing science as it applies to brand equity, sales forecasting, use of imputation and synthetic data, and a rigorous grounding in research statistics.

The following will give a candidate a strong advantage in applying for this role:

* Client facing experience with blue chip brand marketing teams and the insights teams that support them.
* Practical experience of large scale agentic AI applications in quantitative multi-country tracking survey research.

* Interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices
* Solves complex problems; Takes a broad perspective to identify innovative solutions
* Works independently, with guidance in only the most complex situations
* May lead functional teams or projects

Responsibilities

Recognized for deep expertise in a specific discipline or function, solving complex problems and guiding project teams or functional processes.

 **Qualifications**

Qualifications

* Interprets internal/external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve products, processes or services
* Leads others to solve complex problems; uses analytical thinking, tools and judgement to identify innovative solutions
* May lead teams or projects with moderate resource requirements, risk, and/or complexity
* Communicates complex concepts; anticipates potential objections and influences others to adopt a different point of view
* Requires depth and/or breadth of expertise in own specialized area and general knowledge of related areas
* Impacts the achievement of customer, operational, project or service objectives; work is guided by department objectives
* 10-15 years, recognized expertise in a specific area.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree or specialized certifications strongly preferred.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

job_description:
Posted date Oct. 21, 2026

Contract type Full time

Job ID R-262359

  

**Why choose AstraZeneca India?**
---------------------------------

Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.

The part you play in our business will be challenging, yet rewarding, requiring you to use your resilient, collaborative and diplomatic skillsets to make connections. The majority of your work will be field based, and will require you to be highly-organised, planning your monthly schedule, attending meetings and calls, as well as writing up reports.

**Who do we look for?**
-----------------------

Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. We empower people like you to push the boundaries of science, challenge convention, and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. You'll embrace differences and take bold actions to drive the change needed to meet global healthcare and sustainability challenges.

Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting-edge technology. Whether you join us in Bengaluru or Chennai, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.

**Success Profile**
-------------------

Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.

### **Tech innovators**

Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.

### **Ownership takers**

If you're a self-aware self-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.

### **Challenge seekers**

Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

### **Proactive collaborators**

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-262359 **Date posted** 10/21/2026

**Job Title: Senior Product Manager – Enterprise DevOps Platforms**

**GCL: E**

**Introduction to role:**

Are you ready to build and scale a comprehensive DevOps infrastructure that 20,000–30,000 users depend on to move life-changing science to patients faster! This is your opportunity to set the strategy for tools and services that power developer productivity, accelerate delivery, and raise the quality of decision-making across the company. You will feel the sponsorship behind the mission and see the impact of your choices recognized at the highest levels.

You will lead with both vision and execution—bridging business priorities, user experience, engineering capability, oversight, and organizational standards to build a cohesive platform backbone. Working with guides in software development, cybersecurity, system build, and data, you will align Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Copilot and adjacent services into a secure, scalable, AI-enabled ecosystem. Do you thrive on connecting strategic direction with pragmatic delivery to unlock productivity at scale?

Accountabilities:

* Portfolio Product Strategy and Vision: Define and drive the product strategy, vision, and roadmap across the enterprise DevOps platform portfolio, aligning business priorities, engineering needs, platform evolution, and enterprise architecture standards to deliver measurable outcomes.
* Team Leadership and Development: Lead and develop Product Owners across multiple products; set direction, clarify accountabilities, set objectives, coach, handle performance, and build a high-performing, outcome-focused culture.
* Connected Platform Ecosystem: Manage Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Copilot and related DevOps services as an integrated ecosystem, not isolated tools; align roadmaps, priorities, and service improvements to support a coherent enterprise strategy.
* Portfolio Prioritization and Direction: Run portfolio-level prioritization that balances business value, user needs, adoption, operational sustainability, security, compliance, and long-term platform health; translate strategy into clear direction and support Product Owners in delivering agreed outcomes.
* Enterprise-Scale Adoption: Drive large-scale adoption and effective usage across 20,000–30,000 users; remove barriers, improve usability and accessibility, and partner with engineering coaches, platform teams, and business collaborators to increase engagement and realized value.
* Ensure platforms are delivered as scalable, supportable, and maintainable enterprise-grade services. Align these services with policies, governance, and the overall organizational system build. Promote standardization, consolidation, and simplification to reduce fragmentation.
* Security by Build and Governance: Embed security-by-design, DevSecOps practices, least privilege principles, and regulatory expectations across the portfolio; ensure secure defaults and appropriate governance in partnership with engineering, security, architecture, and compliance.
* Senior Collaborator Engagement and Influence: Engage senior leaders across business and technology to understand priorities, reconcile differing needs, and influence decisions; act as a senior extension business, product, engineering, and governance.

Essential Skills/Experience:

* The successful candidate will demonstrate significant experience in a product management leadership role such as Senior Product Manager, Lead Product Manager, Product Lead, or a similar position within a technical, platform, or enterprise tooling environment.
* They will bring strong expertise in DevOps, DevSecOps, CI/CD, developer workflows, and enterprise platform product management, together with experience operating across a sophisticated collaborator environment.
* They will also have confirmed experience in formal people management, including leading, coaching, and developing Product Owners or product professionals within a sophisticated enterprise environment.
* The role requires proven experience in leading teams across various products or services, with the ability to build clarity, alignment, and consistency in delivery and product practices.
* Candidates should have a consistent track record of leading central initiatives, influencing across departments, and delivering outcomes in environments where challenges span multiple teams or functional areas. They should be comfortable operating independently, crafting direction, and combining critical thinking with pragmatic execution.
* Experience in portfolio-level product management is critical, including balancing short-term delivery priorities with long-term strategic value across multiple offerings or solutions.
* This position demands demonstrated capability to drive adoption across large user populations, ideally in environments with 10,000+ users. It also requires improving effective usage through product thinking, change enablement, and engaging collaborators.
* Strong communication, leadership, and influencing skills are critical. If you are able to independently persuade internal and external collaborators, often where priorities conflict, and build alignment around roadmap direction, investment decisions, and product outcomes.

Desirable Skills/Experience:

* Experience with enterprise platforms and tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Actions, GitHub Copilot, Jenkins, SonarQube, and Artifactory would be valuable.
* Experience with cloud platforms, particularly AWS, is desirable.
* Experience working in a regulated environment, including GxP, would be helpful.
* Experience leading AI-enabled product initiatives or defining AI strategy within enterprise platforms would be advantageous.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we fuel aggressive thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.

Why AstraZeneca:

Here, platform decisions turn into real-world impact for patients. We bring surprising combinations of guides together to reinvent how data, machine learning and modern engineering accelerate discovery and delivery. You will shape the backbone that powers science at scale—working with leading specialists, pushing forward with a multifaceted operating model, and learning fast without compromising on doing things the right way. We value grit alongside ambition, coupling high standards with genuine support so you can take bold bets, see your work recognized, and grow your craft while improving lives.

Step in to lead the DevOps platforms within the enterprise that accelerate science. Take ownership of the portfolio and help us build the future of delivery.

**Date Posted**

21-Oct-2026

**Closing Date**

05-Nov-2026

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

### **Explore the local area**

Take a look at the map to see what’s nearby.

**Reasons to Join**
-------------------

### **Thomas Mathisen**

There are many things I enjoy when working at AstraZeneca, mainly the Speak up culture, the great colleagues that are in my teams, the great products that AstraZeneca provides to our patients and the challenging conversations I have around our medicines.

Sales Representative Oslo, Norway

There are many things I enjoy when working at AstraZeneca, mainly the Speak up culture, the great colleagues that are in my teams, the great products that AstraZeneca provides to our patients and the challenging conversations I have around our medicines.

### **Christine Recchio**

Working at AstraZeneca has impacted my life in such a positive way. I now have an improved work-life balance through creating my own schedule and time management, I feel a balance that I didn’t have before.

Sales Representative California, United States

Working at AstraZeneca has impacted my life in such a positive way. I now have an improved work-life balance through creating my own schedule and time management, I feel a balance that I didn’t have before.

### **Stephanie Ling**

There are a lot of reasons why I enjoy working in AstraZeneca, my colleagues being one of them. My team members and the managers have provided a great deal of guidance in helping me to be more confident in my daily work.

Sales Representative Petaling Jaya, Malaysia

There are a lot of reasons why I enjoy working in AstraZeneca, my colleagues being one of them. My team members and the managers have provided a great deal of guidance in helping me to be more confident in my daily work.

**What we offer**
-----------------

We're driven by our shared values of serving people, society and the planet. Our people make this possible, which is why we prioritise diversity, safety, empowerment and collaboration. Discover what a career at AstraZeneca could mean for you.

### **Lifelong learning**

Our development opportunities are second to none. You'll have the chance to grow your abilities, skills and knowledge constantly as you accelerate your career. From leadership projects and constructive coaching to overseas talent exchanges and global collaboration programmes, you'll never stand still.

### **Autonomy and reward**

Experience the power of shaping your career how you want to. We are a high-performing learning organisation with autonomy over how we learn. Make big decisions, learn from your mistakes and continue growing — with performance-based rewards as part of the package.

### **Health and wellbeing**

An energised work environment is only possible when our people have a healthy work-life balance and are supported for their individual needs. That's why we have a dedicated team to ensure your physical, financial and psychological wellbeing is a top priority.

### **Inclusion and diversity**

Diversity and inclusion are embedded in everything we do. We're at our best and most creative when drawing on our different views, experiences and strengths. That's why we're committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive in a culture of respect, collaboration and innovation.
