If you're a self-aware self-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.

### **Challenge seekers**

Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

### **Proactive collaborators**

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-262359 **Date posted** 10/21/2026

**Job Title: Senior Product Manager – Enterprise DevOps Platforms**

**GCL: E**

**Introduction to role:**

Are you ready to build and scale a comprehensive DevOps infrastructure that 20,000–30,000 users depend on to move life-changing science to patients faster! This is your opportunity to set the strategy for tools and services that power developer productivity, accelerate delivery, and raise the quality of decision-making across the company. You will feel the sponsorship behind the mission and see the impact of your choices recognized at the highest levels.

You will lead with both vision and execution—bridging business priorities, user experience, engineering capability, oversight, and organizational standards to build a cohesive platform backbone. Working with guides in software development, cybersecurity, system build, and data, you will align Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Copilot and adjacent services into a secure, scalable, AI-enabled ecosystem. Do you thrive on connecting strategic direction with pragmatic delivery to unlock productivity at scale?

Accountabilities:

* Portfolio Product Strategy and Vision: Define and drive the product strategy, vision, and roadmap across the enterprise DevOps platform portfolio, aligning business priorities, engineering needs, platform evolution, and enterprise architecture standards to deliver measurable outcomes.
* Team Leadership and Development: Lead and develop Product Owners across multiple products; set direction, clarify accountabilities, set objectives, coach, handle performance, and build a high-performing, outcome-focused culture.
* Connected Platform Ecosystem: Manage Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Copilot and related DevOps services as an integrated ecosystem, not isolated tools; align roadmaps, priorities, and service improvements to support a coherent enterprise strategy.
* Portfolio Prioritization and Direction: Run portfolio-level prioritization that balances business value, user needs, adoption, operational sustainability, security, compliance, and long-term platform health; translate strategy into clear direction and support Product Owners in delivering agreed outcomes.
* Enterprise-Scale Adoption: Drive large-scale adoption and effective usage across 20,000–30,000 users; remove barriers, improve usability and accessibility, and partner with engineering coaches, platform teams, and business collaborators to increase engagement and realized value.
* Ensure platforms are delivered as scalable, supportable, and maintainable enterprise-grade services. Align these services with policies, governance, and the overall organizational system build. Promote standardization, consolidation, and simplification to reduce fragmentation.
* Security by Build and Governance: Embed security-by-design, DevSecOps practices, least privilege principles, and regulatory expectations across the portfolio; ensure secure defaults and appropriate governance in partnership with engineering, security, architecture, and compliance.
* Senior Collaborator Engagement and Influence: Engage senior leaders across business and technology to understand priorities, reconcile differing needs, and influence decisions; act as a senior extension business, product, engineering, and governance.

Essential Skills/Experience:

* The successful candidate will demonstrate significant experience in a product management leadership role such as Senior Product Manager, Lead Product Manager, Product Lead, or a similar position within a technical, platform, or enterprise tooling environment.
* They will bring strong expertise in DevOps, DevSecOps, CI/CD, developer workflows, and enterprise platform product management, together with experience operating across a sophisticated collaborator environment.
* They will also have confirmed experience in formal people management, including leading, coaching, and developing Product Owners or product professionals within a sophisticated enterprise environment.
* The role requires proven experience in leading teams across various products or services, with the ability to build clarity, alignment, and consistency in delivery and product practices.
* Candidates should have a consistent track record of leading central initiatives, influencing across departments, and delivering outcomes in environments where challenges span multiple teams or functional areas. They should be comfortable operating independently, crafting direction, and combining critical thinking with pragmatic execution.
* Experience in portfolio-level product management is critical, including balancing short-term delivery priorities with long-term strategic value across multiple offerings or solutions.
* This position demands demonstrated capability to drive adoption across large user populations, ideally in environments with 10,000+ users. It also requires improving effective usage through product thinking, change enablement, and engaging collaborators.
* Strong communication, leadership, and influencing skills are critical. If you are able to independently persuade internal and external collaborators, often where priorities conflict, and build alignment around roadmap direction, investment decisions, and product outcomes.

Desirable Skills/Experience:

* Experience with enterprise platforms and tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Actions, GitHub Copilot, Jenkins, SonarQube, and Artifactory would be valuable.
* Experience with cloud platforms, particularly AWS, is desirable.
* Experience working in a regulated environment, including GxP, would be helpful.
* Experience leading AI-enabled product initiatives or defining AI strategy within enterprise platforms would be advantageous.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we fuel aggressive thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.

Why AstraZeneca:

Here, platform decisions turn into real-world impact for patients. We bring surprising combinations of guides together to reinvent how data, machine learning and modern engineering accelerate discovery and delivery. You will shape the backbone that powers science at scale—working with leading specialists, pushing forward with a multifaceted operating model, and learning fast without compromising on doing things the right way. We value grit alongside ambition, coupling high standards with genuine support so you can take bold bets, see your work recognized, and grow your craft while improving lives.

Step in to lead the DevOps platforms within the enterprise that accelerate science. Take ownership of the portfolio and help us build the future of delivery.

job_description:
**Job Description**

It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.

**Who are we?**

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.  
  
Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

*Summary:*

The Staff Technical Product Manager supports the structured execution, adoption, and expansion of Data, Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence initiatives. The role works across product, business, engineering, infrastructure, and operational stakeholders to translate agreed product direction into organized backlogs, coordinated delivery routines, documented decisions, transparent progress, user feedback, effective communications, and transition readiness.

The position helps teams scale capabilities already built by improving reuse, documentation, communication, adoption, and expansion readiness. It also supports new initiatives by coordinating discovery activities, workshops, stakeholder inputs, feedback, dependencies, and follow-through.

To be successful in this role, you should have a strong background in Data & AI strategy definition and implementation, coupled with excellent leadership and communication skills. Experience in people management and a deep understanding of the business and technology landscape are also highly desirable.

If you are a strategic thinker, a passionate advocate for Data & AI innovation, and a collaborative leader, this Director of AI Strategy role presents an exciting opportunity to drive the organization's digital transformation and shape the future of its AI capabilities.

*Duties and Responsibilities:*

1. Operate a consistent product and delivery cadence across assigned initiatives, including backlog reviews, Sprint planning, daily or regular Scrum meetings, demonstrations, retrospectives, project reviews, and dependency discussions.

2. Maintain product and initiative backlogs in coordination with portfolio leadership, Product Owners, Engineering Managers, and technical leads, ensuring that items are clear, traceable, prioritized through the agreed process, and ready for execution.

3. Coordinating with Engineering Managers and technical leads to track delivery progress against agreed backlog items, milestones, acceptance criteria, risks, dependencies, and documented decisions.

4. Ensure progress visibility for infrastructure, platform, data, security, and other enabling initiatives by aggregating updates from responsible owners and highlighting significant dependencies or risks

5. Organize and facilitate discovery, product, business, and engineering workshops after the product vision and strategic direction have been established; prepare objectives and pre-work, coordinate participants, capture decisions, and track actions.

6. Plan user demonstrations, feedback sessions, testing discussions, and adoption reviews; document feedback, structure themes, route inputs to the appropriate owners, and track agreed responses.

7. Help scale capabilities already delivered by coordinating reusable documentation, playbooks, templates, user guidance, communication materials, knowledge transfer, adoption actions, and expansion readiness.

8. Prepare presentations, portfolio updates, meeting packs, agendas, pre-reads, decision logs, status summaries, and stakeholder communications based on agreed product and portfolio direction.

9. Keep product and initiative documentation accurate and up to date, covering requirements, assumptions, acceptance criteria, decisions, open questions, ownership, dependencies, lessons learned, handover details, and evidence of benefits.

10. Coordinate transition and operational readiness, ensuring that documentation, support ownership, user readiness, training inputs, communication, and post-implementation follow-up are planned and tracked.

*Minimum Qualifications:* (To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.)

* University degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* This position requires a minimum of 7 -10 years’ experience, with hands on experience in the Data & AI Product Management and project management area

*Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:*

* A good understanding of various Data platforms, Cloud or on-prem (Datalake, DWH, Datamarts, Document management, Data interoperability (ETL, API mgt)
* Abilities to define a data & AI platform as a service for enabling other IT teams to benefit from it.

* 7-10 years of overall professional experience in product management, technology program management, digital delivery, data and analytics, business transformation, product operations, or a related field.
* At least 2-3 years of experience in a comparable Product Manager, Product Operations, Agile Program, or technology delivery coordination role.
* Experience running Agile or Scrum ceremonies and maintaining backlogs across one or more business and technology initiatives.
* Experience coordinating Engineering Managers, technical leads, developers, business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, and users in a matrixed environment.
* Experience tracking progress, risks, dependencies, milestones, decisions, and actions across concurrent initiatives.
* Experience facilitating workshops, demonstrations, feedback sessions, planning discussions, and cross-functional working meetings.
* Experience preparing clear presentations, status reports, pre-reads, decision materials, process documentation, and user-facing communications.
* Experience supporting adoption, transition, knowledge transfer, reuse, standardization, or expansion of technology-enabled capabilities.
* Working knowledge of Data, Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, digital products, cloud or infrastructure initiatives, and responsible technology delivery practices.
* Demonstrated ability to influence follow-through without direct authority while respecting product, portfolio, and engineering accountabilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing business priorities.

*Physical Demands and Work Environment:*

* This position is one that would normally require the person to work in a temperature-controlled office environment with other professional and management employees and continent workers, with frequent exposure to electronic office equipment.
* This position will require the employee to maintain hours during a typical day to overlap with team members and business users around the world with special attention to people in the time zones of India, Paris, and the Eastern U.S.
* This position will likely require the employee to travel a few times annually to physically meet with managers or team members.

*About You*

* You bring structure and momentum to complex initiatives without adding unnecessary process.
* You are confident facilitating Scrum ceremonies and product discussions with Engineering Managers, technical leads, senior developers, business stakeholders, and users.
* You can convert product direction and workshop discussions into clear backlog items, decisions, requirements, actions, and communication materials.
* You are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple timelines, dependencies, risks, decisions, and stakeholder commitments.
* You communicate clearly in writing and verbally and can prepare concise, leadership-ready presentations and pre-read materials.
* You listen carefully to users, separate observations from requirements, document feedback objectively, and support evidence-based prioritization.
* You can challenge missing information, unclear ownership, delayed actions, or unmanaged dependencies constructively and respectfully.
* You understand the difference between tracking engineering progress and managing technical quality or individual developer performance.
* You are motivated by scalable outcomes and help teams reuse, document, communicate, adopt, and expand capabilities already built.
* You are a collaborative self-starter who works within agreed portfolio strategy and product vision while taking ownership of execution discipline and follow-through.

**Our Commitment to Embrace Diversity:**

Wabtec is a global company that invests not just in our products, but also our people by embracing diversity and inclusion. We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. At Wabtec, we aspire to create a place where we all belong and where diversity is welcomed and appreciated.

To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. We have created a space where everyone is given the opportunity to contribute based on their individual experiences and perspectives and recognize that these differences and diverse perspectives make us better.

We believe in hiring talented people of varied backgrounds, experiences, and styles… People like you! Wabtec Corporation is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or protected Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

 **Additional Information**

**What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?**

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

**Who are we?**

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

**Culture powers us and the possibilities.**

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

job_description:
Roles & Responsibilities

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager – POS to own the strategy, roadmap, customer

experience, and business outcomes for Ginesys’s POS portfolio across Cloud POS, Offline

POS, Mobile POS, and omnichannel store journeys. You will combine deep retail and POS

expertise with strong product craft to modernise a mission-critical store platform and shape

the future of intelligent store commerce.

Key Responsibilities

1. POS Product Strategy, Market & Discovery

● Own the long-term product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Cloud, Offline, Mobile,

and Omnichannel POS within Ginesys One.

● Build deep understanding of retailers, store associates, market shifts, and global

POS competition to identify whitespace and differentiated product bets.

● Prioritise roadmap investments using customer value, market opportunity,

competitive advantage, revenue potential, and ROI; distinguish scalable needs from

one-off customisation.

● Shape the modernisation and migration strategy for existing POS capabilities while

protecting continuity for enterprise retailers.

2. Modern Store & Omnichannel Experience

● Reimagine core store journeys across billing, payments, promotions, loyalty, returns,

inventory visibility, assisted selling, and endless aisle.

● Design seamless experiences across stores, e-commerce, marketplaces, and

customer channels, including Mobile POS and checkout-anywhere experiences.

● Own product quality across speed, usability, reliability, offline resilience, multi-device

environments, and high-volume enterprise store networks.

3. Platform, Architecture & Product Execution

● Partner deeply with Engineering and Architecture on APIs, data flows, sync, security,

performance, observability, extensibility, and backward compatibility.

● Ensure seamless integration with ERP, OMS, WMS, CRM, loyalty, payments, tax,

e-commerce, and third- party retail ecosystems.

● Translate strategy into crisp requirements, prototypes, workflows, and measurable

release outcomes; make sound trade-offs between speed, technical foundations, and

long-term platform leverage.

● Lead cross-functional execution with Design, Engineering, QA, Customer Success,

and Implementation from discovery through launch and adoption.

4. AI-First Store Innovation

● Identify meaningful AI-native opportunities across checkout, associate assistance,

store operations, recommendations, automation, fraud/risk, and customer

experience.

● Use contemporary AI and rapid prototyping tools hands-on to validate concepts

faster and explore intelligent assistance, natural-language interfaces, and agentic

store workflows.

● Challenge legacy retail workflows and help define what an intelligent, connected

store experience should look like for the next decade.

5. Business Outcomes, Adoption & Monetisation

● Own measurable outcomes across adoption, usage depth, customer satisfaction,

retention, revenue influence, and expansion.

● Define success metrics before launch, track post-launch performance, and use data

and customer feedback to drive continuous improvement.

● Partner with Sales and Marketing on positioning, packaging, competitive

differentiation, and monetisation; equip Customer Success and Support to drive

adoption and customer value.

Pay: ₹2,730,000.00 - ₹4,500,000.00 per year

job_description:
**About the Role:**

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Product Manager with experience building B2C consumer internet products. Someone who understands users, can identify the right problems to solve, and knows how to take a product from an idea to launch.

At FOXO, you'll work closely with founders, designers, engineers, and business teams to shape the product roadmap and turn business priorities into products that people find useful and want to keep using.

This role is suited to someone who enjoys taking ownership, working through ambiguity, and being involved in every stage of product development, from understanding user needs to launching features and improving them based on feedback and data.

**What You'll Do:**

* Own product initiatives from discovery and planning to launch and ongoing improvements.
* Work with founders and leadership to define product priorities and build the roadmap.
* Speak to users, gather feedback, and use product data to understand what needs to improve.
* Turn business requirements and user problems into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with Design and Engineering to build and ship products that are easy to use.
* Identify ways to improve user onboarding, conversion, engagement, and retention.
* Prioritise features based on user needs, business impact, and engineering effort.
* Define product metrics and track how features perform after launch.
* Run experiments and A/B tests to understand what works and what doesn't.
* Study user journeys and drop-off points to identify areas for improvement.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to keep product development and launches on track.
* Maintain clear documentation of product requirements, decisions, and workflows.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must Have:**

* 5–8 years of hands-on Product Management experience, with relevant experience in B2C consumer internet products.
* Experience building, launching, and improving consumer-facing digital products.
* A strong understanding of user behaviour, product discovery, and the product development lifecycle.
* Experience owning product roadmaps and taking initiatives from problem identification through execution.
* Comfort working with product analytics and customer feedback to make product decisions.
* Understanding of key product metrics such as activation, conversion, engagement, retention, and monetisation.
* Ability to write clear PRDs, user stories, product flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise effectively.
* Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams to take products from concept to launch.
* Good communication skills and the ability to work with different teams.
* Comfort working in a startup environment where priorities can change and not every problem has an obvious answer.
* Ability to take ownership and drive projects independently.

**Preferred:**

* Experience working with consumer apps or high-growth B2C businesses.
* Experience building products from an early stage and scaling them as the user base grows.
* Exposure to AI-powered consumer products or AI/LLM-based features.
* Familiarity with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, or PostHog.
* Familiarity with Figma, Jira, and Notion.
* Working knowledge of SQL for analysing product data.

What Success Looks Like:

* Building products that address real user needs.
* Improving user adoption, engagement, and retention through meaningful product changes.
* Using customer feedback and data to decide what to build and what to improve.
* Taking ownership of product initiatives and delivering them with the team.
* Making thoughtful product decisions, learning from results, and improving the product over time.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

* Notice Period

* Expected CTC
* Are you open to relocating to Bangalore?

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Staff Product Manager
job_description:
Build the field software that helps maintain and update information about the network for Electric, Gas, Water or Telecommunications.
  
When work happens in the Field, whether its event driven, maintenance activities, or other planned work, We build the software those crews and Field Engineers use. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead continued improvements to the products at the center of that work: GridOS Field and its unified App and User Experience. One field app supporting many complex business flows and outcomes
  
This role owns how utility field workers capture critical information while performing work. Your decisions will shape how quickly and efficiently utilities capture and maintain data that is constantly changing in the Field.

**Job Description**
===================

Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for product and workflow inside GridOS Field. Your day to day will include:

* **Owning the roadmap.** Set direction for new workflows and enhancements to GridOS Field. Prioritize based on customer needs, technology changes, regulatory drivers, and business impact.
* **Working with customers.** Spend time with utility damage assessors, field supervisors, and control room staff. Validate real problems before writing a single requirement.
* **Working with your Peer Product Management teams who also manage the product lifecycle of GridOS Field**
* **Driving delivery.** Partner with engineering, design, and UX to ship high quality releases on a predictable cadence. Support the Lean operating rhythm.
* **Working with Requirements Management tools: These** tools help document and drive the roadmaps and priorities that help shape strategy, delivery and on-going improvements to GridOS Field
* **Connecting to the platform.** Make sure your products feel like one app with the rest of GridOS Field. Work with the UX PM and the other GridOS Field PMs to keep the experience unified.
* **Using AI.** Apply AI to speed up damage triage, image capture workflows, and data quality checks. Use AI tools in your own workflow to move faster.
* **Supporting sales and delivery.** Join customer calls, write positioning material, and help account teams win and deliver deals with Southern Company, PPL, and the accounts that follow them.
* **Guiding customers off legacy.** Help utilities move from FieldSmart, AEMS, and other legacy tools onto the modern GridOS Field platform.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* Product management or other Management experience with complex enterprise software, ideally in utilities, energy, telecom, or another regulated industry.
* Working knowledge of utility field operations, outage restoration, or ADMS/DMS/OMS and other Field Maintenance Flows. If you have not lived it, you have shipped software to people who have.
* A track record of running more than one program at a time with a clear, data-driven approach.
* Comfort with AI tools in your own product workflow.
* Strong writing and communication. You can turn a messy customer conversation into a clear requirement, a crisp roadmap update, or a one-page memo.
* Commercial judgment. You can connect a product decision to a revenue, cost, or customer outcome.
* A Lean and Agile mindset. You adjust quickly when priorities shift, and you close things out.

**Education Requirements**
--------------------------

**For US candidates:** A Master's degree, or a High School Diploma/GED with at least six years of professional experience.

**For non-US candidates:** A Master's equivalent, or a High School Diploma with relevant professional experience.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

You will work on software that utilities depend on during their most challenging times to maintain infrastructure stability while experiencing exponential growth in demand. restoring service.

We offer:

* **Real impact.** Providing Value to Large Tier 1 and Tier2 Utility and Telco companies, with a clear runway to grow.
* **Modern stack.** Single-tenant SaaS on hyperscaler infrastructure, with AI built in through the Prism platform.
* **Direct customer contact.** You talk to the people using the product, not just the people buying it.
* **Growth.** GridOS Field is scaling. Strong PMs move up.

**Success in This Role**
------------------------

You will know you are succeeding when the Adoption rate of GridOS Field increasing and becomes a key part of both our existing customer base and prospects.

**Working Arrangement**
-----------------------

Permanent, fully remote. Occasional travel to customer sites and GE Vernova offices.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from everyone who meets the criteria and is interested in the future of the grid.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

title: Product Lead - AI
job_description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Oversight** **& Best Practices:** Optimize product management processes, employing AI where possible and proactively identify areas for standardization and improved efficiency (e.g. Service Descriptions), document and implement.
* **Roadmap Support**: Oversee process for product managers in developing and managing roadmaps; coordinating feedback for process improvements, and preparing client and senior management-ready roadmap views near on-demand.
* **Governance Coordination**: Support execution of annual **Wealth Investment Governance Board** by defining and coordinating PM driven templates, supporting content creation, execute logistics and run of show and following up on actions.
* **Strategic Support**: Opportunity to contribute to ad hoc strategic client or internal projects and initiatives as directed by Senior Management, such as documentation and coordination across product for Strat Planning, Growth Day and Client Sales Opportunities.
* **AI:** Assist teams in utilizing BR AI tools to capture valuable product insights that support their strategies and client adoption. Contributing to and supporting the Wealth AI task force, and ideating on new innovations to support the COE and managing reporting and metrics.

**What Success Looks Like:**

  

* Implemented Service Description workflow and attestation process, including coordinated legal updates and tracking of common elements.
* Ability to produce on-demand roadmaps by product or Wealth overall as required both from clients and internally
* Efficiently executed internal events that impact and advance our strategic Wealth initiatives, providing clear actions and follow ups with stakeholders and clients.
* Become a Go-To Product COE expert in support of our Product teams, ensuring their success in delivering high quality roadmaps, ideas and processes.
* Delivery of well documented processes and best practices available to all associates, maintained and updated consistently
* AI driven process ideation and implementation of our product management process, creating efficiencies and best practices adopted across the COE.

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

**Use of AI in Hiring**

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Technical Product Manager - Principal
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager / Solutions Architect – Design Automation & AI Workflows**
===================================================================================

**Company Overview**  
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

**Want to Help Shape How Chips Are Designed in the Future?**

* How would you automate workflows that have traditionally required years of engineering expertise?
* How would you combine AI, optimization, and domain knowledge to solve challenging problems across analog, custom digital, and standard cell design?
* How would you help customers migrate decades of intellectual property between design environments?
* How would you create products that make engineers dramatically more productive while improving design quality?
* How would you take breakthrough ideas from concept to deployment at the world's leading semiconductor companies?

That's what we do. We're looking for people who are excited about solving difficult problems and making a meaningful impact. You'll work at the intersection of semiconductor design, AI, product strategy, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate understands complex design challenges, can translate customer needs into product requirements, and enjoys helping bring innovative technologies from concept to production.

**Responsibilities**

* Define product requirements and workflows for next-generation design automation solutions.
* Work directly with customers to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and validate proposed solutions.
* Drive product direction for technologies across analog design, standard cell design, custom digital implementation, design migration, and design automation.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to translate customer needs into product capabilities and deliverables.
* Define use cases, success metrics, benchmarks, and customer adoption strategies.
* Lead evaluations, demonstrations, customer engagements, and early-access deployments.
* Influence roadmap priorities based on market needs, customer feedback, and competitive analysis.

**Requirements**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience in semiconductor design, EDA, or related technical fields.
* Experience defining solutions, workflows, or products that have been successfully delivered to users or customers.
* Experience applying automation, AI, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI technologies to engineering workflows.
* Strong understanding of one or more of the following domains:
  + Analog and custom IC design
  + Standard cell design and optimization
  + Physical implementation
  + Design migration and design reuse
  + Semiconductor design automation
  + Physical verification, extraction, and simulation workflows
* Experience working directly with customers to gather requirements and drive technology adoption.
* Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively across product management, engineering, sales, and customer teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Analog and custom IC design workflows.
* Circuit simulation, SPICE, and analog verification flows.
* DRC, LVS, parasitic extraction, and physical verification.
* OpenAccess-based design environments.
* Experience with commercial EDA platforms such as Cadence Virtuoso.
* Delivering software products used in production semiconductor design flows.
* Technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

We are looking for product leaders who are excited by emerging technology, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to help shape the future of semiconductor design. Success in this role requires a combination of technical depth, customer focus, business judgment, and the ability to turn innovative ideas into widely adopted solutions.

**Why us?**  
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility — choosing between working at home and the office (with state-of-the-art facilities in Bangalore and Noida) at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

job_description:
Job ID

26WD101350

**Job Requisition ID #**

26WD101350

**Position Overview**

  
  

Autodesk is seeking a strategic and technically skilled Senior Product Manager to lead the modernization of our Marketing Technology (MarTech) ecosystem, with a primary focus on end-to-end Lead Management and pipeline progression.

In this role, you will define and execute product strategy across the lead lifecycle, from lead capture, enrichment, scoring, qualification, routing, and engagement through pipeline progression and conversion. You will collaborate closely with Attribution, Analytics, Data, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to ensure Lead Management capabilities are seamlessly connected across the broader MarTech ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in Marketing Technology and Lead Management with strong product management skills and a passion for leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to transform how leads are identified, qualified, prioritized, engaged, and converted.

You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Data Science, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Analytics teams to build intelligent, scalable solutions that improve lead quality, optimize seller productivity, accelerate pipeline progression, and drive revenue growth.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

  
  

* Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for the MarTech portfolio, focusing on end-to-end Lead Management and pipeline progression while aligning technology investments with business objectives
* Lead the evolution of the Lead Management ecosystem, including lead capture, lifecycle management, enrichment, deduplication, scoring, qualification, routing, prioritization, engagement, and conversion
* Own the end-to-end lead-to-revenue experience, identifying opportunities to reduce friction and optimize conversion across every stage of the sales funnel
* Partner with Data Science and Engineering teams to develop and enhance Machine Learning (ML) and predictive models for lead scoring, qualification, prioritization, and conversion
* Drive AI-powered lead engagement and qualification through AI agents, AI-powered Sales Development Representative (AI-SDR) capabilities, and Copilot solutions that automate repetitive workflows, improve lead coverage, and provide sellers with timely, actionable insights
* Define strategies to improve lead quality and enrichment by leveraging first-party and external data sources to provide relevant context for qualification, scoring, routing, and seller engagement
* Establish measurable strategies and feedback loops to continuously improve lead scoring, qualification, routing, and conversion performance
* Partner with the Marketing Attribution Product Manager to define requirements and ensure attribution capabilities support end-to-end lead-to-pipeline measurement and decision-making
* Collaborate with GTM Product Managers to drive cross-functional initiatives and ensure Lead Management capabilities integrate seamlessly across Customer Relationship Management (CRM), marketing automation, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), analytics, advertising, and other GTM systems
* Define product requirements, prioritize roadmaps, and collaborate with Engineering, User Experience (UX), Architecture, Technical Program Management, and Data teams to deliver high-impact solutions
* Leverage data, experimentation, and customer insights to identify opportunities, measure product success, and continuously improve lead-to-revenue outcomes
* Build strong relationships with Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Data Science, Finance, and executive stakeholders to align product investments with business priorities
* Champion AI innovation, experimentation, automation, and continuous improvement across the Lead Management ecosystem
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  
  

* 10+ years of Product Management experience, including significant experience in Marketing Technology, Lead Management, or Go-to-Market (GTM) technology
* Deep expertise in end-to-end Lead Management, including lead lifecycle management, enrichment, scoring, qualification, routing, prioritization, engagement, and pipeline progression
* Strong understanding of modern GTM systems, including Customer Relationship Management (CRM), marketing automation, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Business Intelligence (BI) platforms, and sales engagement technologies
* Experience developing data-driven products and collaborating with Data Science or Machine Learning teams
* Strong understanding of lead scoring methodologies, predictive models, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and marketing measurement
* Proven ability to translate complex lead-to-revenue processes and business requirements into scalable product solutions

title: Sr. Product Manager I
job_description:
We are looking to hire a Senior Product Manager I to own the integrations and agentic ecosystem for Brandfolder, Smartsheet's Digital Asset Management platform. This is a high-growth, strategically critical product area. It covers how Brandfolder connects to the tools where marketing and creative teams work, and how AI agents find, use and govern brand content through MCP, connectors, APIs and partner integrations.

Your work will determine whether Brandfolder is the trusted source of brand content for people and AI agents alike. This is an individual contributor role for a product leader with strong technical fluency, deep customer instincts and the confidence to drive a complex, cross-surface product area across multiple engineering teams and external partners.

**You Will**
------------

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Brandfolder's MCP server, connector framework, public API and integrations and make clear prioritization and sequencing decisions
* Define how AI agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot discover, retrieve, create and update brand assets, while keeping permissions, usage rights and brand governance intact
* Lead the evolution of Brandfolder's integration portfolio
* Define the API and agent-readiness strategy: authentication, scopes, rate limits, webhooks, tool design and developer experience for customers, partners and AI clients
* Own the quality, reliability and supportability of existing integrations, and shape the migration path from legacy connectors to the new platform
* Lead customer and partner discovery sessions to validate assumptions
* Author crisp product briefs, requirements and technical specs that design and engineering can execute without ambiguity, from discovery through GA and post-launch
* Drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, security, GTM, Customer Success, Support and partner teams
* Define success metrics for every feature, such as integration adoption, active accounts, agent task success, API usage and work with data teams to ensure instrumentation from day one
* Represent product in leadership reviews, MBRs, partner conversations and customer engagements
* Contribute to packaging and pricing decisions for integrations and AI capabilities

**You Have**
------------

* 4+ years of product management experience delivering high-impact features in enterprise SaaS or B2B software
* Experience owning platform, API, integration, connectors or developer-facing product areas, including how products work with AI models and agents is a strong plus
* Experience with content, digital asset management, marketing technology or workflow products is a plus
* Proven ability to navigate ambiguous, technically complex problem spaces and make clear scoping and sequencing decisions across multiple engineering teams and external partners
* A working understanding of authentication and authorization (OAuth, SSO, role-based permissions), APIs and webhooks, and data security considerations for AI
* Strong customer instincts: you run structured discovery, synthesize signal and turn it into well-scoped, validated decisions
* A track record of excellent product briefs, requirements and specs that engineering acts on without ambiguity
* Demonstrated ability to drive alignment across engineering, design, security, GTM and Customer Success, including third-party partner dependencies
* A data-driven mindset: you define adoption, funnel, quality and reliability metrics before you ship and use post-launch data to guide iteration
* Excellent written and verbal communication

job_description:
**ABOUT REVANTAGE**

Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services.

With a corporate purpose of ‘In Pursuit of Better,’ Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company’s footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific.

Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry.

In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform.

**India**

With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.

Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly **Build What Matters.**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

We are seeking a Senior Director – Financial Systems for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India.

The Senior Director – Financial Systems serves as Finance’s product owner for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle Cloud EPM, with responsibility for translating Finance and Accounting priorities into scalable system capabilities, standardized processes and well-controlled solutions. The role partners closely with Finance, Accounting, FP&A and IT to establish the platform roadmap, govern functional design and investment priorities, and strengthen the systems and processes supporting close, planning, reporting and decision support.

**Primary Role – Oracle Fusion ERP and Oracle EPM Product Ownership**

  

* Own the functional product vision, roadmap and prioritized backlog for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle Cloud EPM, aligning investments to Finance strategy and measurable business outcomes.
* Lead Finance’s role in implementation and enhancement programs from business case and process design through requirements, testing, cutover, stabilization and benefits realization.
* Serve as the senior Finance functional leader for Oracle Fusion Financials, including General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Expenses, Intercompany, Tax, Subledger Accounting and financial reporting, and guide connected Procurement and Project Management scope as applicable.
* Lead product ownership for Oracle EPM across planning, consolidation, close, account reconciliation, enterprise data management and management reporting, enabling an integrated and scalable plan-to-report process.
* Establish governance for demand intake, prioritization, change control, release planning and executive decisions; communicate trade-offs, risks and realized value to senior stakeholders.
* Partner with IT to define Finance requirements for integrations and data flows across Fusion ERP, EPM and adjacent applications, establish reconciliation and control standards, and ensure timely resolution and escalation of material issues.
* Establish and maintain master data governance across ERP and EPM, including clear ownership, standards, stewardship and approval processes in partnership with key business stakeholders.
* Maintain a strong financial systems control environment, including role-based access, segregation of duties, workflow approvals, change management, audit evidence and SOX compliance.
* Lead Finance readiness and user adoption for Oracle quarterly releases and other platform changes, including impact assessment, testing, process documentation, training, communication and change management.
* Lead and develop the Financial Systems team, establishing clear performance expectations, building functional and technical capability, and ensuring appropriate capacity to support implementation and ongoing platform ownership.
* Manage Finance’s relationship with key implementation partners, consultants and technology vendors, ensuring alignment with functional priorities, delivery expectations and business outcomes.
* Drive continuous improvement across Finance processes and systems, identifying opportunities to standardize workflows, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls and improve reporting and decision support.
* undefined

* **QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**
  + Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, information systems, business administration or a related field is required; MBA, CPA, CA or other relevant advanced credential is preferred.
  + 12+ years of progressive financial systems, finance transformation, ERP/EPM product management or related consulting and industry experience.
  + At least five years of leadership experience managing teams and large cross-functional business transformation initiatives.
  + Deep functional experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Financials and Oracle Cloud EPM, including core financial close, planning, consolidation, reconciliation and reporting processes.
  + Demonstrated leadership of at least one full-cycle Oracle Fusion ERP and/or Oracle EPM implementation, major transformation or global rollout through post-production stabilization.
  + Experience with fit-to-standard design, functional configuration, data conversion, integration coordination, testing, deployment, release management and change adoption.
  + Strong understanding of internal controls, segregation of duties, SOX or comparable control environments, and audit requirements for cloud financial applications.
  + Demonstrated ability to translate finance process requirements into system design and challenge unnecessary customization.
  + Ability to balance strategic product leadership with disciplined execution, resolve complex cross-functional issues and make sound, timely decisions.
  + Exceptional stakeholder management, communication and executive presentation skills; real estate, asset-intensive, multi-entity or highly regulated industry experience is preferred.
  + Work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with working hours aligned to provide meaningful daily overlap with US business hours; flexibility is expected during system implementations, quarter-end and year-end close, major releases and other peak periods.
  + Partner with US-based leadership and Revantage India on staffing, hiring, performance management and organizational development to ensure the Financial Systems team has the appropriate capacity and capabilities to support the business.
  + Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

*Job Applicant Privacy Notice*

***EEO Statement***

*The Company is an equal opportunity employer. In accordance with applicable law, we prohibit discrimination against any applicant, employee, or other covered person based on any legally recognized basis, including, but not limited to: veteran status, uniformed servicemember status, race, color, caste, immigration status, religion, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex, gender, gender expression, gender identity, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation or related medical conditions), age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), protected leave status, domestic violence victim status, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations, if you need an accommodation to complete the application process, please email* *TalentAcquisitionIndia@revantage.com*

* Scrum ceremonies, automation and modernization opportunities

**Mott MacDonald** is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

  

We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be **brilliant**.

**Job Description:**

  

We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, governance and strategic direction across the technology that supports our global People services.

  

The People Technology Service & Experience Product Manager will provide accountable ownership for the People Service & Experience portfolio, ensuring that global People services, employee and manager journeys, case management, knowledge, self-service and lifecycle automation are governed, prioritised, optimised and developed in line with business priorities.

  

Reporting to the Group People Technology Manager, you will lead and develop the Service & Experience product team and work closely with the People Technology Portfolio & Operations Lead, Senior Product Specialists, Project Managers and colleagues across the wider function.

  

You will work with People teams, business regions, IT, Security, Finance, Procurement, Enterprise Architecture, external partners and suppliers. The portfolio initially centres on ServiceNow HRSD and is expected to include Qualtrics and colleague-listening capabilities, alongside integrations with SAP SuccessFactors, OpenText, Microsoft products and other enterprise platforms.

  

You will own the product strategy, roadmap, backlog, performance and continual improvement of the Service & Experience portfolio. You will help the business establish consistent global ways of working and create joined-up employee and manager journeys, while ensuring the portfolio delivers measurable business value today and evolves towards stronger experience design, orchestration, automation and self-service.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, governance and strategic direction across the technology that supports our global People services.
* The People Technology Service & Experience Product Manager will provide accountable ownership for the People Service & Experience portfolio, ensuring that global People services, employee and manager journeys, case management, knowledge, self-service and lifecycle automation are governed, prioritised, optimised and developed in line with business priorities.
* Reporting to the Group People Technology Manager, you will lead and develop the Service & Experience product team and work closely with the People Technology Portfolio & Operations Lead, Senior Product Specialists, Project Managers and colleagues across the wider function.
* You will work with People teams, business regions, IT, Security, Finance, Procurement, Enterprise Architecture, external partners and suppliers. The portfolio initially centres on ServiceNow HRSD and is expected to include Qualtrics and colleague-listening capabilities, alongside integrations with SAP SuccessFactors, OpenText, Microsoft products and other enterprise platforms.
* You will own the product strategy, roadmap, backlog, performance and continual improvement of the Service & Experience portfolio. You will help the business establish consistent global ways of working and create joined-up employee and manager journeys, while ensuring the portfolio delivers measurable business value today and evolves towards stronger experience design, orchestration, automation and self-service.
  

**Candidate Specification:**

  

**Essential**

  

* Significant experience managing enterprise technology products, platforms or services within a complex organisation.
* Significant hands-on experience with ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, including product ownership, roadmap planning, workflow or service development and stakeholder management.
* Experience defining product strategies, roadmaps, backlogs and priorities and translating business requirements, service challenges and strategic objectives into measurable digital outcomes.
* Experience leading and developing product, platform, service-management or technology teams, with responsibility for performance, coaching, prioritisation and capability development.
* Strong understanding of HR service delivery, case management, service catalogues, knowledge management, employee and manager self-service and workflow automation.
* Experience designing or improving employee and manager journeys, services or lifecycle events across multiple business functions.
* Experience supporting global service standardisation while balancing regional, operational and regulatory requirements.
* Experience managing product demand, incidents, defects, enhancements, optimisation opportunities and investment decisions within a structured governance framework.
* Experience owning delivery outcomes through internal teams, integrated delivery teams and third-party implementation or support partners.
* Experience working with business stakeholders and non-People functions to define responsibilities, requirements and hand-offs within cross-functional services or lifecycle journeys.
* Strong stakeholder leadership, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge constructively, build consensus and operate effectively at senior leadership level.
* Experience operating within a product-led delivery model and establishing product governance, processes and ways of working within new, evolving or transforming technology environments.
* Ability to balance immediate operational priorities with medium and long-term product strategy, service transformation and experience-design objectives.
* Experience using platform performance, service information, stakeholder feedback and business outcomes to drive continual improvement and investment decisions.
  

**Desirable**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification.
* ServiceNow HR Service Delivery implementation, product or specialist certification.
* Additional ServiceNow certifications relating to platform implementation, application development, workflow automation, service management or customer workflows.
* Experience within People Technology, HR Technology or enterprise employee-service portfolios.
* Experience with Qualtrics or comparable colleague-listening, survey or experience-management platforms.
* Experience applying service design, experience design, journey mapping or user-centred design practices.
* Experience designing or managing global service catalogues, service taxonomies, case-management models or knowledge-management frameworks.
* Experience supporting employee lifecycle orchestration across People, IT, Security, Facilities, Procurement, Learning, identity or background-screening processes.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with SAP SuccessFactors, OpenText, Microsoft products or other enterprise platforms.
* Experience supporting digital transformation, operating-model change or organisational mobilisation initiatives.
* Experience developing and leading communities of practice, super-user groups, champion networks or People Technology Communities.
* Experience working within a global, complex or matrixed organisation.
  

**Qualifications & Certifications: Desirable**

  

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator
* ServiceNow HR Service Delivery certification
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist certification
* Qualtrics certification or relevant experience-management qualification
  

**Product and Delivery**

  

* SAFe Product Manager / Product Owner
* AgilePM
  

**Scrum Product Owner**

* Scrum Master
  

**Service and Experience Management**

* ITIL Foundation or higher certification
* Service design or experience-design qualification
  

Journey-mapping, user-experience or human-centred-design certification

This role is expected to help build and mature the People Technology function and establish Service & Experience as a strategic product capability, rather than simply operate an established ServiceNow platform.

  

**Flexible working**
  
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.

  

**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing
  

**Employment Compliance Requirement**

As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
  
By applying, you **confirm** that you can provide valid documentation if and when required.

job_description:
**Senior Product Manager / Solutions Architect – Design Automation & AI Workflows**
===================================================================================

**Company Overview**  
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

**Want to Help Shape How Chips Are Designed in the Future?**

* How would you automate workflows that have traditionally required years of engineering expertise?
* How would you combine AI, optimization, and domain knowledge to solve challenging problems across analog, custom digital, and standard cell design?
* How would you help customers migrate decades of intellectual property between design environments?
* How would you create products that make engineers dramatically more productive while improving design quality?
* How would you take breakthrough ideas from concept to deployment at the world's leading semiconductor companies?

That's what we do. We're looking for people who are excited about solving difficult problems and making a meaningful impact. You'll work at the intersection of semiconductor design, AI, product strategy, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate understands complex design challenges, can translate customer needs into product requirements, and enjoys helping bring innovative technologies from concept to production.

**Responsibilities**

* Define product requirements and workflows for next-generation design automation solutions.
* Work directly with customers to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and validate proposed solutions.
* Drive product direction for technologies across analog design, standard cell design, custom digital implementation, design migration, and design automation.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to translate customer needs into product capabilities and deliverables.
* Define use cases, success metrics, benchmarks, and customer adoption strategies.
* Lead evaluations, demonstrations, customer engagements, and early-access deployments.
* Influence roadmap priorities based on market needs, customer feedback, and competitive analysis.

**Requirements**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience in semiconductor design, EDA, or related technical fields.
* Experience defining solutions, workflows, or products that have been successfully delivered to users or customers.
* Experience applying automation, AI, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI technologies to engineering workflows.
* Strong understanding of one or more of the following domains:
  + Analog and custom IC design
  + Standard cell design and optimization
  + Physical implementation
  + Design migration and design reuse
  + Semiconductor design automation
  + Physical verification, extraction, and simulation workflows
* Experience working directly with customers to gather requirements and drive technology adoption.
* Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively across product management, engineering, sales, and customer teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Analog and custom IC design workflows.
* Circuit simulation, SPICE, and analog verification flows.
* DRC, LVS, parasitic extraction, and physical verification.
* OpenAccess-based design environments.
* Experience with commercial EDA platforms such as Cadence Virtuoso.
* Delivering software products used in production semiconductor design flows.
* Technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

We are looking for product leaders who are excited by emerging technology, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to help shape the future of semiconductor design. Success in this role requires a combination of technical depth, customer focus, business judgment, and the ability to turn innovative ideas into widely adopted solutions.

**Why us?**  
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility — choosing between working at home and the office (with state-of-the-art facilities in Bangalore and Noida) at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday
