title: Senior Tech Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

We are seeking a highly motivated Technical Product Manager (TPM) to lead the strategy, development, and scaling of next-generation healthcare data and AI-driven products. This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, analytics, and operations, translating complex healthcare challenges into innovative digital solutions that improve clinical, operational, and member outcomes.

Success in this role requires strong product management expertise, technical depth, healthcare domain knowledge, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business value.

You will partner with engineering, architecture, data science, operations, and business stakeholders to define product vision, prioritize investments, and drive adoption of scalable solutions that support strategic healthcare initiatives.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product Strategy & Vision
  + Define and execute short and long-term product strategies, roadmaps, and investment priorities for healthcare technology products and platforms
  + Partner with business leaders, customers, and technology teams to identify opportunities that improve healthcare outcomes, operational efficiency, and business performance
  + Translate strategic objectives into product capabilities, business cases, and prioritized delivery plans
  + Define product success metrics, KPIs, customer outcomes, and value realization measures
* Product Ownership & Delivery
  + Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation, discovery, and definition through launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement
  + Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans
  + Prioritize and manage product backlogs to maximize customer value and business impact
  + Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, compliance, privacy, and governance requirements
  + Monitor product performance and continuously refine priorities based on data, customer feedback, and market insights
* Healthcare Data & AI Enablement
  + Drive development of healthcare data products, analytics platforms, AI/ML capabilities, and intelligent automation solutions
  + Collaborate with data engineering and data science teams to define data acquisition, integration, governance, analytics, and consumption strategies
  + Identify opportunities to leverage generative AI, predictive analytics, machine learning, and automation to improve workflows and decision-making
  + Define requirements for APIs, interoperability solutions, reporting platforms, and healthcare data services
  + Ensure data quality, lineage, governance, and regulatory requirements are embedded within product designs
* Cross-Functional Leadership
  + Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, engineering teams, architects, data scientists, operations, and leadership
  + Facilitate alignment across multiple teams and portfolios to deliver integrated product solutions
  + Influence priorities and drive decisions in a complex matrixed environment without direct authority
  + Communicate product vision, roadmap, progress, risks, and outcomes to senior leaders and stakeholders
* Agile Execution & Operational Excellence
  + Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, release planning, and prioritization activities
  + Ensure product initiatives are decomposed into actionable features and well-defined user stories
  + Manage dependencies, delivery risks, and trade-off decisions across teams
  + Leverage Agile methodologies and product management best practices to improve delivery effectiveness and speed to market
  + Drive continuous product improvement through experimentation, measurement, and customer feedback
* Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  + Present product strategy, roadmap, business value, and performance metrics to executive leadership
  + Collaborate with business development, operations, implementation, and client teams to identify emerging opportunities
  + Mentor product owners and product managers while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and collaboration
  + Act as a trusted advisor on healthcare technology trends, AI adoption, and product best practices
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in product management or equivalent
* 8+ years of experience in Technical Product Management, Product Development, Digital Product Management
* 5+ years of experience defining product requirements, writing user stories, and managing Agile product backlogs
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale technology products, platforms, or data-driven solutions
* Experience working with cloud platforms, APIs, microservices, data platforms, analytics, and digital technologies
* Experience collaborating with engineering, architecture, analytics, data science, and business teams
* Experience using product management and Agile tools such as Jira, Rally, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
* Experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve product capabilities, business processes, or customer experiences
* Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and modern product management practices
* Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into scalable technical solutions
* Demonstrated solid analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex cross-functional dependencies

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working within healthcare, payer, provider, population health, payment integrity, claims, clinical, or healthcare analytics domains
* Experience delivering AI/ML, Generative AI, intelligent automation, or advanced analytics products
* Experience with cloud-native architectures, modern data platforms, APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems
* Experience leading large-scale digital transformation or enterprise modernization initiatives
* Experience defining and tracking product KPIs, customer adoption metrics, and business value outcomes
* Knowledge of healthcare data standards, interoperability, governance, privacy, and compliance requirements
* Familiarity with healthcare operational workflows, clinical programs, and digital health solutions
* Solid understanding of product portfolio management, roadmap planning, and investment prioritization
* Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive alignment across complex organizations

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Product Manager - Liquidity & Account Solutions Product Development - Vice President
job_description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Shape the future of global liquidity by helping deliver modern, client-first capabilities at scale. Join a team where you will partner across product, technology, and operations to turn complex needs into delivered outcomes. Bring your product and analysis expertise to a role with strong visibility, growth opportunities, and mobility across a global payments organization.

As a Product Vice President at JPMorganChase within Payments, Liquidity and Account Solutions Product Development, you will drive delivery of money market fund capabilities as part of a multi-year liquidity platform transformation. You will act as a primary liaison between product owners and technology delivery teams to define clear requirements and enable predictable execution. You will translate current-state behaviors and client needs into a prioritized backlog of features, user stories, and acceptance criteria. You will partner with engineering, operations, user experience, and business stakeholders to deliver agreed milestones with strong quality and risk discipline. You will help ensure solutions are scalable, user-friendly, and aligned to evolving market and regulatory expectations.

This role supports a global initiative modernizing liquidity and account services for large multinational corporate and financial institution clients. The work spans multiple regions and stakeholder groups and requires strong coordination across product, technology, and operational partners. You will help close current-state gaps while defining a clear target state that supports faster product innovation and improved client experience. Success will be measured through delivery of prioritized capabilities, clarity of documentation, and effective stakeholder alignment. Coverage flexibility is required to support United States business hours through 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time, with occasional extension based on critical delivery needs.

Job Responsibilities

* **Develop** deep domain knowledge of liquidity and money market fund offerings, including client workflows, constraints, and value drivers.
* **Lead** cross-functional execution across product, engineering, operations, and regional stakeholders to deliver committed milestones.
* **Analyze** existing processes and documentation to understand current-state behavior and identify gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* **Define** target-state requirements using clear artifacts such as epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
* **Own** backlog prioritization and readiness by running refinement sessions and maintaining a delivery-ready pipeline of work.
* **Validate** sprint outcomes against acceptance criteria and coordinate timely resolution of scope and requirement questions.
* **Support** test planning and execution by ensuring scenarios cover requirements and by assisting with user acceptance testing and defect triage.
* **Drive** stakeholder communication by translating complex technical, operational, and regulatory inputs into clear decisions and next steps.
* **Contribute** to operating model and governance improvements, including disciplined risk and control practices and data/analytics ways of working.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

* Bachelor's degree and prior experience in a product manager, digital product owner, business analyst or equivalent role.
* Prior experience as a product manager, digital product owner, business analyst, or equivalent role.
* Demonstrated ability to produce and manage requirements artifacts (for example, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows).
* Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with technology teams and business stakeholders to deliver outcomes.
* Demonstrated written and verbal communication skills, including ability to simplify complex concepts for senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a delivery-oriented environment with strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
* Commitment to sound risk and control practices.
* Flexibility to support business coverage needs through 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time (with occasional extensions based on delivery needs).

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

* Experience with liquidity and/or money market fund products.
* Experience working with data analysis, large datasets, and/or modeling.
* Experience using digital tools, including artificial intelligence-enabled tools, to accelerate documentation and requirements definition.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Product Lead
job_description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**Product Lead – Skills**

1. Strong domain and business knowledge in relevant product, operations, and technology areas.

2. Experience working with agile product delivery teams across multiple squads.

3. Strong knowledge of backlog management, prioritization, release planning, and dependency management.

4. Ability to assess business value, urgency, risks, capacity constraints, and delivery trade-offs.

5. Experience using Jira, ESM, dashboards, and reporting tools for backlog and delivery visibility.

6. Strong stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Delivery, Operations, SMEs, and business teams.

7. Ability to translate product strategy and business needs into actionable priorities for squads.

8. Strong communication, influencing, and problem-solving skills.

9. Experience coaching or mentoring Product Owners, Business Analysts, or similar roles.

10. Understanding of functional requirements, non-functional requirements, technical debt, production support, and continuous improvement.

11. Ability to work effectively in a complex environment with high request volumes and competing priorities.

12. Understanding of agile principles, product operating models, and governance practices.

**Product Lead – Roles & Responsibilities**

1. Act as the domain-level product lead for a defined area, such as Core, Print, or Voting/Tabulation/Edit Load.

2. Translate Product Manager strategy, roadmap priorities, and business objectives into clear direction for Product Owners and squads.

3. Support prioritization and sequencing of work across squads, including discretionary initiatives, run/OCC work, lite requests, regulatory work, production support, and technical debt.

4. Review incoming requests for business value, urgency, timelines, dependencies, impacted squads, capacity implications, and governance needs.

5. Ensure requests are categorized and prioritized using agreed criteria, such as Critical, High, Medium, and Low.

6. Work with Product Owners to align squad backlogs with domain priorities, roadmap commitments, and available capacity.

7. Guide Product Owners on backlog quality, requirement readiness, prioritization, stakeholder communication, and dependency management.

8. Participate in key business and refinement discussions for complex, high-priority, cross-squad, or high-risk initiatives.

9. Ensure appropriate SME involvement for discovery, technical clarification, spikes, and requirement validation.

10.Coordinate with Delivery Managers, Engineering leaders, QA leads, SMEs, and Scrum Masters on delivery constraints, dependencies, and sequencing impacts.

11. Maintain visibility into domain-level capacity, delivery risks, blockers, resource constraints, and impacts to roadmap commitments.

12. Identify and escalate priority conflicts, major trade-offs, cross-squad dependencies, and delivery risks to the Product Manager when needed.

13. Support domain intake reviews, backlog reviews, prioritization discussions, and governance preparation.

14. Provide regular domain-level updates on priorities, progress, risks, capacity, dependencies, and milestone impacts.

15. Coach and support Product Owners; where needed, directly perform Product Owner responsibilities for specific initiatives, including gathering requirements, creating/refining stories, managing backlog items, and supporting delivery through completion.

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

**Use of AI in Hiring**

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

job_description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

Product Owner/ Business Analyst – Tax Reporting  
Experience: 3 to 6 Years Job Requisition: TBD  
About the Role  
We’re seeking a Business Analyst / Product Owner with strong expertise in U.S. tax reporting and securities processing. You’ll act as the bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams, ensuring our products meet complex IRS requirements while driving operational efficiency for global clients. This role combines product ownership, business analysis, and Agile/Scrum leadership to deliver impactful financial solutions.  
Key Responsibilities  

Product Ownership  
Define and prioritize product backlog items with a focus on IRS/regulatory compliance (cost basis, income reclassification, tax form production).  
Act as Product Owner in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, ensuring clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and alignment with business goals.  

Agile & Scrum Delivery  
Collaborate with Scrum Masters and development teams to drive sprint planning, backlog refinement, and timely delivery.  
Champion Agile practices, fostering transparency, adaptability, and continuous improvement across teams.  

Cross-Functional Collaboration  
Partner with Development, QA teams across geographies to deliver scalable, compliant solutions.  
Facilitate workshops, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to align stakeholders and ensure shared understanding of product goals.  

Client Engagement  
Work directly with clients and partners to capture reporting needs, regulatory changes, and operational challenges.  
Translate complex tax and securities requirements into actionable user stories and product features.  

Domain Expertise  
Apply deep knowledge of IRS/regulatory practices, withholding, corporate actions, and back-office operations.  
Ensure solutions meet tax reporting/regulatory standards with accuracy, reliability, and audit readiness.  
Qualifications  

Hands-on industry experience in U.S. Tax Reporting and Securities Processing.  

Strong knowledge of IRS requirements for cost basis, income, withholding, and form production.  

Experience with back-office platforms (BPS, BETA preferred).  

Demonstrated success working in Agile/Scrum environments as a Product Owner or Business Analyst.  

Technical expertise in SQL, PostgreSQL, and Power BI for advanced data analysis, reporting, and visualization.  

Strong communication abilities, adept at engaging with clients and stakeholders.  

Education: BE / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or equivalent.  

Flexibility to work in rotational shifts when required.
